name: Mikel Cortes
description: Currently working as a Software and Research Engineer at ProbeLab, he used to work at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center and MigaLabs, while he was awarded a PhD research fellowship from Protocol Labs. During the fellowship he had the opportunity to collaborate on various research projects with entities like Protocol Labs, the Filecoin Foundation, the Ethereum Foundation, the University of Cambridge, and the Codex Storage team at Status.
